requirements.ordinary_base: Keep exact trimmed base string; existing quantity, price, notional, funds, position and eligibility validators apply. Do not repair off-step user quantities.
requirements.ordinary_quote_limit: quote amount / entered limit, rational division, floor to existing LOT_SIZE step/minimum convention.
requirements.ordinary_quote_market: quote amount / buy ask or sell bid, rational division, floor MARKET_LOT_SIZE. Missing required quote blocks; no opposite/Mark/Last fallback.
requirements.quote_is_not_margin: Never multiply entered quote order notional by leverage.
requirements.confirmation: Capture immutable resolved base quantity before review or explicit skip-confirm submit. Only base quantity reaches POST, signature and journal; no quantityUnit/quoteOrderQty for ordinary orders. Recovery queries retain original ID and exact quantity.
requirements.defaults: Opening input defaults to quote and blank, limit BUY/GTC, first valid Last snapshot seeds accepted PRICE_FILTER once, conditional and trailing default Mark; trailing activation and callback blank. Never overwrite read account settings.
requirements.editing: Base and quote raw strings independent and retained; direction/type/limit/context changes recalculate before confirmation. User-edited/cleared limits not overwritten by refresh. Unknown operation locks size edits.
requirements.close: Dedicated position-close defaults to base; choosing a position fraction switches to base, entire-close ignores dormant amount and transmits no quantity.
requirements.attachments: PnL/ROI conversion and full-main-quantity protection use resolved base quantity, not quote amount.

local_indicative_extensions.conditional_market: Use entered trigger as named estimate; existing conditional LOT_SIZE policy retained.
local_indicative_extensions.ordinary_bbo: Use snapshot Mark as explicitly named indicative reference, not an engine BBO execution price.
local_indicative_extensions.trailing: Use snapshot of explicitly chosen Mark/Last; missing Last blocks.
local_indicative_extensions.guarantee: These are Vanta local estimates, not an exchange quote-budget guarantee. UI names reference, amount, base quantity, estimated notional and UTC snapshot; execution amount can exceed input and this is not a spending cap.

boundaries: No new transport, wallet, signing credential or actionable quote budget stored. Connected EOA remains user=signer; no replacement wallet.
Normal market/limit conversion directly follows PRD. Indicative extensions are local rules and must not be described as an official Aster quote-budget execution contract.
Last seed requires positive accepted price; no Mark fallback or silent rounding into a different price. Missing/off-tick Last leaves limit blank for explicit entry.
No account configuration mutation on load. Existing market confirmation preference unchanged; per-mode/limit+Post Only preference alignment remains incomplete.
Scaled total quote input/distribution/defaults, Chase recovery, main navigation defaults and custom slippage execution contract remain separately incomplete.
Freshness, auth/operation locks, actual account limits and execution acceptance are inherited validators. Automated tests cannot prove live EOA signer permissions or actual fills.
Native testing deferred by user; no device tools, wallet signatures, private API requests, financial actions or address-bearing RPC calls.
